name: Ambermill
summary: Ambermill's wizards hold a fortified outpost in southeastern Silverpine Forest, southwest of Lordamere Lake. Once a quiet lumber village, it now shelters surviving wizards and apprentices from Dalaran, resisting the Forsaken on their southern borders.

sections.title: A Bastion of Dalaran
sections.body: Ambermill was a quiet lumber town before the Third War. After Lordaeron fell, surviving wizards of the Kirin Tor moved in and fortified the settlement. Dalaran spellscribes, conjurors, and apprentices now patrol its buildings and stables, keeping this forward redoubt against the undead.

sections.title: Tapping the Ley Lines
sections.body: Ambermill draws the Kirin Tor for more than defense. The village lies over a dormant ley line energy node. Forsaken spies and Deathstalkers watching the town have learned that Dalaran's magi are trying to awaken the nexus for large-scale arcane work. The surge could threaten the Forsaken's fragile hold on Silverpine Forest. Shadow Priest Allister and the Deathstalkers are working to stop them through sabotage, stolen Kirin Tor documents, and assassinations across the mill grounds.

faq.q: Why are Dalaran wizards occupying a village in Silverpine?
faq.answer: After Dalaran was devastated during the Third War, surviving Kirin Tor forces moved into Ambermill to establish an outpost of living human resistance. Forsaken agents are investigating their activities.

faq.q: Was Ambermill always part of Dalaran?
faq.answer: No. Before the Third War, Ambermill was a minor lumber village. Dalaran's wizards moved in and fortified it only after the Scourge overran Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to attack Ambermill?
faq.answer: Ambermill is a fortified center of human opposition in Silverpine Forest. The Forsaken see its Dalaran-supported forces and secret arcane work as threats to their hold on the region.

faq.q: What are the Deathstalkers searching for in Ambermill?
faq.answer: Forsaken Deathstalkers learned from captured human prisoners that Ambermill's wizards keep secured documents detailing Dalaran's secret plans and military intentions. The settlement is now a main target for covert infiltration and theft.

angles.text: As a Forsaken operative, you face one of Silverpine's few remaining pockets of living human resistance. Ambermill threatens southern logistics and harbors dangerous arcane secrets.
As a mage, you see the Kirin Tor trying to restore their influence after the Scourge and Burning Legion devastated Dalaran.
